content.short: Falora teaches real-world English through a feed of short videos with tap-to-translate words.
content.description: Falora is a language-learning feed of short videos in everyday English, where any word can be tapped for an instant translation, with an optional WLD stake-to-learn challenge. It is built for World App and listed in World's ecosystem directory.
content.meta: Falora teaches everyday English through short videos with tap-to-translate, built as a World App mini app.
